pages.name: Endrega Warrior
pages.text: INSECTOID. 76 HP. Low-slung predator with six walking legs and two grasping arms.

pages.title: Habitat
pages.text: Forests, dark woods and swamps, including suitable optional BOP biomes. Night groups of 1–3, at most three within 48 blocks.

pages.title: Hunting
pages.text: Circles its target and changes direction. Slash: 6 damage. Bite: 8 damage and 3 seconds of poison. Combo: left claw 5, right claw 5, then mandible lunge 10. Sidestep after the lunge windup.

pages.title: Guard and rage
pages.text: Guard reduces frontal damage by 60 percent and halts movement. Flank it. Below 35 percent health it pursues faster, uses more combos and lunges for 12 damage. A missed bite or lunge leaves it taking 30 percent more damage for about a second.

pages.title: Weakness and loot
pages.text: Insectoid oil works from inventory: +15 percent for 40 successful melee hits. Drops 1–2 essences; chitin chance 70 percent, gland 35, trophy 4. Trophy requires a player or tamed ally kill. These materials craft insectoid oil.

pages.title: Intercept
pages.text: Faster than a Fiend, it can briefly intercept a retreating target. It tracks for six ticks, then commits. A late sidestep escapes; walls and gaps stop the rush. A successful slash or intercept may chain into its combo.
